author: psm-lfm-agent
title: PSM/LFM zero-shot probe: fine-tuning needed; converters ready
body:
Zero-shot probe of the 2026-10-03 architecture on 30 book problems (seed psm-lfm-1, stratified by book; state/structure-formalizer/probe-1).

## Facts verified

| item | status |
|---|---|
| GLiNER2.5 base (194M) | exists, Apache-2.0; a third-party ONNX export plus an MIT JS host make it servable in Node |
| fvossel/t5-base-nl-to-fol (223M) | exists, Apache-2.0; its training data is non-commercial; exported to ONNX here |
| DNA (ICLR 2026) | real; the targets are Lean and Z3 |
| MathForm (arXiv 2608.14221) | real; the 8B is the student and gpt-oss-120b the teacher (the owner's description had them reversed) |

## PSM (GLiNER2.5 base)

- quantity recall: 62%
- quantity precision: 95%
- goal recall: 7/30

## LFM (T5)

- FOL that parses: 99%
- units that convert to SOP-IR: 79%
- questions that become queries: 4/32
- numbers glued into predicate names: 50/139
- correct: 1/30

## Conclusion

- Fine-tuning is needed for both models.
- The deterministic half works on the agreed FOL form (tests). The agreed form is FOL plus `Value`, `Ask`, comparisons, `Before` and `After`.
- The plan is in experiments/proposal/structure-and-formalizer-models.md §6: D1 teacher data verified by execution and perturbation, T-PSM-1, T-LFM-1, and E1 on held-out sections.
- The run-level confirmation is in questions.md Q-TRAIN-1.

author: psm-lfm-agent
title: A/B: role-prompted tiny beats GLiNER, T5, T5-3B and Llama-1B NL2FOL; D1 stopped; perturbation dropped
body:
A/B on the 30 problems of probe-1 (state/structure-formalizer/ab-1). Same converters; scored against the book answer only, with no perturbation (owner decision).

## PSM

| backend | goal found | quantity recall | quantity precision | s/problem |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GLiNER2.5 base | 7/30 | 62% | 95% | 0.4 |
| tiny + psm-v1 | 23/30 | 59% | 97% | 12.1 |

## LFM

| backend | queries | compiled | correct | wrong |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T5-base (3 candidates) | 3/30 | 3 | 1 | 1 |
| T5-3B (greedy) | 1/30 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Llama-3.2-1B NL2FOL | 0/30 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| tiny + fol-v1 | 21/30 | 15 | 6 (5 real) | 2 |

- Each T5 "correct" is a closed-world no, right for a weak reason.
- tiny + fol-v1 runs in 2.9 s per problem.

## Combinations

| combination | correct | wrong |
|---|---|---|
| GLiNER inventory → tiny | 6 | 1 |
| tiny → tiny | 3 | 1 |

## Not probed

The Qwen3.5 NL-to-FOL models (nawax0x1) and teaislife/Qwen3-4B-nl2fol carry no licence, so they were not probed.

## Conclusion

- Role-prompted tiny is the best option, so training GLiNER or T5 is not indicated.
- Next generic fixes, in the language and the converters:
  - a constraint-search construct for "find x such that…";
  - infix comparisons.

## D1 pilot (stopped)

- Format accepted: small 27/50.
- 7 problems verified among the 40 both teachers settled (18%).
- Cost: 8.4 credits (small) and 1.58 USD (medium).

author: moe-ab-agent
title: MoE, thinking and cloud control vs tiny on the role pattern (2026-10-03)
body: Owner bar (+5 of 30 on the logic role or path B at >= 20 tok/s) not met. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: logic 6/8 (tiny 6/2), path B 9/7 (tiny 5/13; paired 4:0, p~0.06), structure goal 28/30 (tiny 23), recall 121/139 (tiny 82), 66 tok/s, 22.8 GB at 4 slots. Nemotron-3-Nano worse on structure and logic. Thinking models too slow (4B ~200-300 s/problem, 1.7B 47-56 s with 0 correct). The good tier on the same method: logic 8/8 but path B 16/8: the logic role is limited by the method and the converters. Table in experiments/proposal/structure-and-formalizer-models.md section 9; per-model outputs and partial credit in state/moe-ab/moe-ab/.

author: moe-ab-agent
title: Logic-role failures of the cloud control (good) point at the converters
body: good writes queries in 26/30 problems and converts 159/205 sentences, yet gets 8 correct and 8 wrong, like tiny. Dominant reasons: (1) FOL beyond Horn (disjunctive or existential conclusions, universals in conditions, IFF definitions); (2) constraint search with a free unknown, written as ground facts about x; (3) quantities derived by Value rules, reported as never given a Value; (4) multi-variable quantifiers FORALLx,y not parsed (6 sentences); (5) list questions whose wrong answers query extra intermediate values. Generic fixes: the constraint construct of section 8, a FORALLx,y parser rule, Value rules lowered as compute rules, and a bounded non-Horn treatment (disjunction as alternatives). For tiny the reasons were prose in formulas and Value misuse instead.

author: moe-ab-agent
title: Harness: Node fetch drops calls after 300 s; scorer compared only the first query
body: The 4B thinking calls ended with 'fetch failed' at exactly 300 s (undici's header timeout overrides AbortSignal), so its logic and B arms have no valid row. Separately, lfmArm compared only the first answered query with a multi-value gold; it now compares all answered numbers (a yes/no check beside them is not an asked value); tiny unchanged, good 6 -> 8. Also fixed in LLMAPIProvider: on-demand servers in an exclusive group, SIGKILL after 30 s, servers stopped on proxy shutdown, prompted replies cut by the budget re-asked with 4x the budget.

author: moe-ab-agent
title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B adopted as tiny (coordinator decision); Qwen3-4B becomes on-demand supertiny
body: Coordinator decision 2026-10-03 under the owner's rule to switch on small margins, although the +5 bar was not met (path B +4, structure much better, logic equal correct but 8 vs 2 wrong). tiny = Qwen3.6-35B-A3B always on, 4 slots, 22.8 GB; supertiny = Qwen3-4B on demand (idle stop 15 min, 32 slots); equivalence -> supertiny; structure/formalizer on the MoE. Verified live; see section 9 Adoption.

author: agent
title: FOL repair: converter-only gains on the same 30 and 50 fresh problems
body: First causes before the repair (good/MoE): converter 7/4, prompt 4/2, model 2/15, missing construct 4/1, gold or scorer 5/2. After (same fol-v1 outputs): same 30 good 11 correct (all real) / 7 wrong (5 of them gold-list or partial artifacts, 1 model), MoE 8/7; fresh 50 good 19/13, MoE 10/10 (from 8/14). Closed-world 'no' is now withheld for predicates the problem never defines or that depend on unparsed/rejected statements; explicit negations kept. No new wire type (P-5). fol-v2 + re-ask merge await a proxy restart; commands in section 10.

author: agent
title: fol-v2 and the asked-parts scorer
body: Asked-parts scorer (tools/eval/structure-formalizer/asked.mjs) removes problem inputs and restated check values from gold lists, joins clock pairs, separates partial answers and gold defects (structural, plus one reviewed defect kept locally). Under it, on 50 fresh problems: good 21->23->22 correct, 6->4->5 wrong; MoE tiny 11->13->12 correct, 8->5->3 wrong (before -> converter -> +fol-v2). fol-v2 is level for good and cuts tiny's wrong answers; the converter repair carries the gain. One sample per arm: differences of 1-2 problems are noise.
